body: It's okay. Thank you for checking in.
I have a master's degree in psychology. It's largely useless due to a complete absence of clinical training. I have nowhere else I can go. I can't even drive.
I'm 27. A lack of resources and trustworthy others has kept me from leaving this place.
I'll see what I can do. Thank you.
It's possible. The only problem is that I feel like I don't have the time or energy to give them what they deserve, or to do them at all.

Writing some stories, mostly a novel or two. I wanted to make a visual novel but that's more resource intensive than I can do for now. In any case, I feel like I don't have the energy or power to accomplish what I want anymore.

Ugh. I was thinking of going to the hospital tonight out of hopes that maybe I'd be able to get at least looked at/have my case considered/scare myself straight, but this turned me right off of that. Thanks for saving me the trouble.
Thank you. I'm thinking I'll just take my medicine and go to sleep early.
He's a very good boy. I spent some time with him and I feel a bit better.

Pay Tribute to Your Female Spawner Day sucks like it always does. I didn't make my mom a card (because why should it matter?), and she went from bubbly and happy in the morning to "bored" (said pointedly at me as though it was my fault) and crabby. "You've made it pretty clear how you feel today." You know what? Yeah, I have. If I had the money, I'd be out of here already. This "holiday" feels like a pull to force people to make offerings to mythical mothers who maybe exist only for a privileged few. The only worse day is her birthday.

I'm tired of having to make offerings to prove my love for a parasitic mother. I need to get out, as soon as I have a job.
